meta.name: linkedin-ads-outbound-sync
meta.description: Synchronize LinkedIn Ads engagement with outbound sales for coordinated ABM plays. Use when the user asks about aligning LinkedIn ads with sales outreach, using ad engagement as sales triggers, ABM sales coordination, multi-channel ABM plays, or combining ads with email/calling sequences. Triggers on "ads outbound sync", "ABM sales alignment", "ad engagement triggers", "ads + outbound", "coordinate ads sales", "multi-channel ABM". Do NOT use for targeting setup (use audiences) or campaign structure (use campaign-setup).

copy.tagline: 将LinkedIn广告互动与销售外呼自动同步
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要协调LinkedIn广告与销售团队行动
copy.tagline_en: Sync LinkedIn ad engagement with outbound sales automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to align LinkedIn ads with sales outreach

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你协调 LinkedIn 广告与对外销售，根据广告互动（如点击、视频观看）自动触发销售跟进动作，并构建多渠道 ABM 流程（广告+邮件+电话等）。
howto.when: 当用户询问如何对齐 LinkedIn 广告与销售外联、使用广告互动作为销售触发、ABM 销售协调等话题，或提到“ads outbound sync”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我对齐LinkedIn广告和销售外联。
say.note: Claude会指导设置广告互动跟踪和销售触发规则。

say.text: 把广告点击作为销售跟进触发条件。
say.note: Claude会定义触发阈值并建议下一步行动。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you coordinate LinkedIn Ads with outbound sales, automatically triggering sales follow-ups based on ad engagement (e.g., clicks, video views) and building multi-channel ABM plays (ads + email + calls, etc.).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about aligning LinkedIn Ads with sales outreach, using ad engagement as sales triggers, ABM sales coordination, or mentions keywords like "ads outbound sync".

say_en.text: Align my LinkedIn ads with outbound sales.
say_en.note: Claude will guide setting up engagement tracking and trigger rules.

say_en.text: Use ad clicks as triggers for sales follow-up.
say_en.note: Claude will define trigger thresholds and suggest next steps.
